description: Spends the user's Freebeat credits. quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Use this when the user wants new still images from a text prompt. Flow: list_models(type=image) -> get_model_help -> generate_image -> get_task_status with the returned batch_id. For changes to an existing image, use edit_image. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: true means the user accepted that the total is unknown; used without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; no total budget is enforced.

custom_resolution.description: Use a custom resolution when the model supports it.

max_credits.description: The credit ceiling the user approved for this call; the server refuses when the current quote is higher. It cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run.

output_format.description: Output format when the model supports it, for example png or webp.

quality.description: Image quality when the model supports it, for example low, medium, high.

resolution.description: Image resolution when the model supports it.

size.description: Image size or aspect ratio when the model supports it, for example 1024x1024 or 16:9.

name: generate_image

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

batch_id.description: Open RPC batch ID for get_task_status.

anyOf.description: Whether the batch response was retrieved; check accepted_count and items[].accepted for acceptance.
